violated_contract: After a tap the reader must see what happened. A request that failed must not reach the page as the same value as a real answer (null, {}, [], false read as 'nothing new', 'up to date', 'Free plan' or 'no change'), state the reader made must not be cleared before the request that could fail has answered, and a write that rolls back must say so where the reader is looking. On 2026-11-18 a Finish with content and no server answer cleared the transcript, removed the processing row, announced the absence silently and popped the reader to Home with no message.
canonical_prevention: Return a typed outcome that separates 'nothing there' from 'could not find out' (FinishOutcome for every Finish entry point; a nullable lookup for firmware; RestoreOutcome for Restore Purchases), present it through one shared helper (presentFinishOutcome, applyOmiSetting, OmiMissingTarget), and keep the no-increase ratchet rules silent-catch, generic-error and pop-before-await so new pages cannot reintroduce the pattern.
